_help: One voice per character for AI4Bharat Indic Parler-TTS. 'description' is the natural-language voice prompt (keep it in English, the model expects that). 'seed' keeps the voice consistent between lines: change it to try a different take. 'filter' is an optional ffmpeg audio filter applied after generation. Edit freely and re-run generate.py with --force for that character.
